site: Gmail browser verification for Bank of America application 140
class: Mailbox navigation hint mistaken for authenticated account identity
symptom: Opening Gmail with authuser set to the newly selected application email loaded the old signed-in mailbox. The agent previously deferred opening Gmail solely because no mail tab existed.
root_cause: Mail readers checked only that the loaded URL contained mail.google.com. Gmail can silently fall back to its default account when the requested account is not signed in; the URL does not prove which mailbox loaded.
why_tests_missed: Existing tests asserted the requested URL and supplied a synthetic inbox without its account identity; they did not simulate silent account fallback.
fix: Verify the exact visible Google Account button email before reading any passcode, verification link or confirmation snippet. On mismatched or unknown identity, open and retain the add-account sign-in tab with a precise handoff. Google passwords remain a human step. Opened the browser and confirmed only the old mailbox is signed in; new-address Google sign-in is awaiting the owner. The separate Workday registration timing/state-reporting defect is not established as fixed.
prevention: Use observed mailbox identity before reading messages. An absent Gmail tab does not imply an absent browser session, and a requested account URL does not imply that account loaded.
